Language Lab

Present Continuous: Right Now on Maple Street

Amanda Foster · your guide for this lab

Hi, I'm Amanda! I teach here in European Garden. Let's look at the grammar together, and I'll show you the mistakes I hear most from Portuguese speakers. No judgment, everyone makes these at first!

How it works

subject + am / is / are + verb-ing
  • Mrs. Wilson is waving.A Mrs. Wilson está acenando.
  • Ethan is carrying a box.O Ethan está carregando uma caixa.
  • Sophie is riding her bike.A Sophie está andando de bicicleta.
  • Biscuit is running with a toy.O Biscuit está correndo com um brinquedo.
  • Antonio is baking bread.O Antonio está assando pão.
Spelling tip ride → riding (drop the e) · run → running (double the n)

Your turn: Talk · Guess Who

Play with a partner. Student A silently picks one person from the picture. Student B asks yes/no questions with the Present Continuous to guess who it is. Ten questions max!

Is he wearing a hoodie? Is she smiling? Is he riding something? Is she carrying anything? Is he standing near the truck? Is she wearing an apron?
